description:
Create or replace an organization skill from a SKILL.md and optional supporting files. The skill's name and description come from its frontmatter. Publishing under a well-known name, governance or design-system, replaces what Valet would otherwise supply for every agent in the organization from the next read on, so do it when the user has asked to change how the organization works, and show them the content first. Publishing under a new name adds a skill the default governance process finds through list_skills when its description applies.

Destructive because it replaces the previous version's content for every reader. Repeating a call with identical content mints no new version and reports deduped. Requires connecting a Valet account.

files.description: Supporting files: [{path, content}], text only, paths relative to the skill root.

content.description: Required. The file's complete text content.

path.description: Required. The file's path, relative to the skill root.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to publish into. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill_md.description: Required. The complete SKILL.md, with name and description frontmatter.

name: publish_skill
title: Publish an organization skill
